application_credentials.description:
Follow the [instructions]({more_info_url}) to configure Smartcar for your vehicle:

1. Go to [Applications]({oauth_creds_url}) and your application from the list.
1. Copy the credential whose **Client ID begins with `client_`**, and its secret. This is the API credential, used by the current v3 API. It is **not** the UUID shown as *Application ID*: that one is asked for in the next step, not here, and entering it here will fail with `oauth_unauthorized`.
1. On a legacy v2 account there is no `client_` credential. Use the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** from **Configuration** instead.
1. Regenerate the secret only if you are replacing it everywhere, because regenerating invalidates the previous one.
1. Add `{redirect_url}` under *Authorized redirect URI*.

confirm.description:
{title} is using deprecated Smartcar v2 API. To migrate to v3.0:
 - Remove all Smartcar integrations that use v2. _Note: this is required for the next step._
- Remove all _Application Credentials_ that use a v2 `client_id`. To be safe, you can remove all Smartcar credentials from the _Application Credentials_.
- Re-setup each smart car integration, ensuring that you use the new v3 _API credentials_ and _Application ID_ rather than _Legacy Credentials_.

Read the [documentation]({docs_url}) for more information.
confirm.title: Smartcar v2 API deprecated

polling_without_webhook.title: Smartcar is polling without a webhook subscription
polling_without_webhook.description:
{title} is polling the Smartcar API on a schedule. Without a webhook subscription Smartcar only refreshes vehicle data about once every 24 hours, so scheduled polling spends the 500 calls per vehicle per month allowance without producing newer data.

Subscribing the vehicle to a webhook gives updates as often as the manufacturer allows, and costs nothing from the allowance. See {docs_url}.

polling.title: Polling and API budget
polling.description: Smartcar allows 500 API calls per vehicle per month on the free tier, and a vehicle that is not subscribed to a webhook only refreshes its data about once a day. Polling harder costs calls without producing newer data. This profile currently schedules about {estimate} calls a month against an allowance of {budget}.

data.poll_interval_hours: Interval in hours (used by the Custom interval profile)
data.presence_entities: People or device trackers to watch
data.low_battery_threshold: Treat the battery as low below this percentage
data.daily_event_cap: Maximum event driven refreshes per day
data.monthly_budget: API calls allowed per vehicle per month
data.auto_subscribe_webhook: Subscribe vehicles to the webhook automatically

data_description.poll_profile: Webhooks only makes no scheduled calls at all and is the cheapest and freshest option. On demand only refreshes when an automation or the Refresh action asks, plus once a day if someone is away from home.
data_description.presence_entities: Where the people are is free to watch. A phone leaving home is a better reason to ask the car where it is than a timer is.
data_description.daily_event_cap: Stops a device tracker that flaps between home and away from spending a month of allowance in an afternoon.
data_description.budget_reserve: Commands are billed from the same allowance. These calls are never spent on polling, so a lock or a charge stop always has room.
